content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python (Part 1)
    - Lesson 1: Python Essentials for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Working with CSV Files in Python
    - Lesson 3: Exploring and Understanding Datasets
    - Lesson 4: Basic Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Intro to NumPy Library
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Pandas Library
    - Lesson 7: Filtering, Grouping and Merging DataFrames
    - Lesson 8: Time Series Analysis with pandas

   Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis (Part 2)
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Pandas Functions
    - Lesson 2: Introduction to Seaborn Library
    - Lesson 3: Statistical Analysis using SciPy Library
    - Lesson 4: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 5: Data Visualization with Matplotlib (advanced)
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Machine Learning Algorithms (Classification)
    - Lesson 7: Regression Analysis using Scikit-learn
    - Lesson 8: Building and Evaluating Machine Learning Models

   Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: JOIN Operations (Inner, Outer)
    - Lesson 4: WHERE Clause and Filtering Data
    - Lesson 5: GROUP BY Clauses and Aggregations
    - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Complex Queries
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Normalization
    - Lesson 8: Database Design Concepts (Schemas, Indexes)

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Removal
    - Lesson 3: Data Normalization Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering and Selection
    - Lesson 5: Text Preprocessing for NLP
    - Lesson 6: One-hot encoding and Target Encoding
    - Lesson 7: Handling Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 8: Data Augmentation Techniques

   Track: Introduction to Power BI (for Integrating Python Outputs)
    - Lesson 1: Power BI Overview and Navigation
    - Lesson 2: Importing Data from Various Sources
    - Lesson 3: Basic Data Transformations in Power BI
    - Lesson 4: Building Tables, Charts, and Reports
    - Lesson 5: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques
    - Lesson 6: Publishing and Sharing Dashboards
    - Lesson 7: Integrating Python with Power BI (using Power Query)
    - Lesson 8: Building Interactive, Real-time Reporting Solutions

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
    - Lesson 1: EDA Overview and Importance
    - Lesson 2: Visualizing Data Distribution
    - Lesson 3: Correlation Matrix and Heatmaps
    - Lesson 4: Clustering and Segmenting Data
    - Lesson 5: Time-Series Analysis Techniques
    - Lesson 6: Regression Analysis (visualization)
    - Lesson 7: Classification Analysis (visualization)
    - Lesson 8: Anomaly Detection and Outlier Analysis

   Track: Business Intelligence and Data Storytelling
    - Lesson 1: Importance of BI in Decision Making
    - Lesson 2: Identifying Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
    - Lesson 3: Building Dynamic and Interactive Reports
    - Lesson 4: Creating Data-Driven Narratives
    - Lesson 5: Presentation and Visualization Best Practices
    - Lesson 6: Effective Data Storytelling Techniques
    - Lesson 7: Creating Engaging Data-driven Presentations
    - Lesson 8: Data-driven Decision Making Case Study
